content:
emily: Quick heads-up — did a sweep comparing KV pager watermark thresholds + prefetcher windows across H100 (us-west) and A100 (eu-west). Saw surprising p99 spikes on short seqs.

karthik: interesting, which thresholds did you try?

emily: baseline is watermark=0.7 (70% GPU mem), aggressive=0.85, conservative=0.5. Prefetch windows: 8, 32, and 128. seq mix: 8/32/512 ratios to simulate chat, completion, long-context.

sean: can you paste the config you ran?

emily: sure — ran with the following override:```yaml
kv_pager:
  watermark: 0.85
  prefetch_window: 32
  eviction_policy: lru_proportional
  max_prefetch_tokens: 1024
  sample_rate: 0.02
```

maya: what was the metric set? p50/p95/p99 for latency and cache hit rate?

emily: exactly. Also measured tokens/sec per GPU and observed paging IO ops/sec. Short summary from benchbot below.

benchbot: run-summary:
- target: gpt-small-serve (kv-enabled)
- traces: chatlike (mix 8/32/512)
- h100/us-west (watermark=0.85, prefetch=32): p50=18ms, p95=52ms, p99=210ms, cache_hit=86%, io_ops=420/s
- a100/eu-west  (watermark=0.85, prefetch=32): p50=22ms, p95=65ms, p99=480ms, cache_hit=84%, io_ops=780/s
- h100/us-west (watermark=0.5, prefetch=8): p99 drops to 95ms, cache_hit=62%, throughput -18%
- a100/eu-west (watermark=0.5, prefetch=8): p99 130ms, cache_hit=60%

karthik: wow p99 doubled on a100 for the same settings. Could be kernel selection or PCIe host memory path differences.

sean: do we have kernel logs? maybe prefetch scheduling is getting starved under high io on A100 cluster.

emily: attached minimal log excerpt:```
[2025-11-02T14:12:03Z] kvpager: prefetch window=32, candidate_pages=120
[2025-11-02T14:12:03Z] io: page_fault batch=14 latency_ms=12
[2025-11-02T14:12:03Z] runtime: selected_kernel=matmul_v2_opt
[2025-11-02T14:12:03Z] runtime: fallback_kernel=matmul_generic (used for 7% requests)
[2025-11-02T14:12:04Z] kvpager: eviction_sweep=on, evicted=340 pages
```

maya: fallback_kernel use at 7% could explain p99 tail. Which binpack / kernel selector version on eu-west?

emily: eu-west machines are on kernel-selector v1.9.1, us-west on v2.0.0-rc. We rolled v2 to us-west last week.

karthik: hypothesis: new kernel has better partial-kv handling and avoids fallback path, hence lower p99 on H100. Also A100 host IO seems higher io_ops which lines up with p99.

sean: let's rerun small test: keep watermark 0.7 but force kernel-selector=v2.0.0 on a single a100 host and compare. Also try prefetch=128 — maybe larger window amortizes IO bursts.

emily: scheduled quick run on a100-test-03 with kernel=v2.0.0 and prefetch=128 (job id: bench/205123/3). Will post results.

benchbot: queued job bench/205123/3. ETA 18m.

maya: one more ask — capture KV hit distribution by seq bucket (<=16, 17-128, >128) and include per-bucket p99. That made debugging easier last time.

emily: will add that. preliminary notes: conservative watermark reduces p99 but hurts throughput and hit rate. Aggressive watermark saves throughput but can induce fallback kernel cascades on older selector versions.

karthik: thanks — this is actionable. If kernel update reduces fallback rate on A100, we can keep higher watermark for cost efficiency. If not, consider regional defaults (A100: conservative watermark=0.6).

sean: cc @ops to check PCIe interrupts / firmware versions on eu-west A100 hosts. Sometimes driver mismatch shows as higher io latency.

emily: noted. will follow up when bench/205123/3 completes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

benchbot: job complete — posting delta:```
- a100-test-03 (kernel=v2.0.0, prefetch=128): p50=20ms, p95=58ms, p99=135ms, cache_hit=88%, io_ops=460/s
- delta vs previous a100: p99 down from 480ms -> 135ms, io_ops halved, fallback_kernel use <1%
```

maya: incredible - kernel selector upgrade + larger prefetch fixed most of the tail.

emily: conclusion notes: recommend promoting kernel-selector v2 rollout to eu-west and set default prefetch_window=64 for mixed seq workloads. For A100 keep watermark conservative default=0.6 until rollout validated across fleet.

karthik: agree. please open rollout PR with canary plan and include the per-bucket p99 charts.

emily: filing PR now. Thanks all. :tada:
